plain.li: I know which floorboards creak in this place now, every one of them.
I can tell who's coming down the hall by their footsteps now.
When I first got here I gave this place a month, at most.
[old] Of all the places I've lived, this is the one I'll be buried in.
[newcomer] It still feels new here, though less so every day.
[winter] Another winter here, and I've finally learned where the drafts get in.
[grieving] I'd raise a cup, but not everyone who was here a year ago is still with us.
[lowtech] Another year of woodsmoke in my hair, and I've stopped noticing it.

warm.li: I came here with nothing, and now I've got all of you.
Thank you for keeping me around all this time.

blunt.li: Still hate the rice, still here, another year on.
Don't make a fuss over it, or at most a small one.

cheerful.li: Happy anniversary to me, and I'll take my presents in extra dessert!
Best year here yet, mud and all!

gloomy.li: One more year survived, though the odds get worse each time.
I never expected to last this long out here.

cold.li: Another year of my work here, and I expect it to be remembered.
